messages:
maya: Heads-up — thinking through UX for per-route vs per-model saved views in Console Analytics. Platform teams want quick route-scoped filters; product teams want model-presets.
kevin: Yep. Main tension: users expect URL/permalink to return same view, but we also need fast cross-route model compares.
sam: API idea: two-layer saved views — "Route View" (route_id, timeframe, route filters) and "Model Lens" (model_id, model filters, token breakdown). Console composes them when opening a route.
elaine: UX nit: show composed context in the breadcrumb? e.g. /routes/checkout • Model: redwood-v1 — or use a small pill? Concern about space.
maya: Also need precedence rules for telemetry sampling & quotas. If a Route View pins sampling=0.1 but Model Lens requests full sample, which wins?
kevin: Customer contracts and quotas always win. Route-level sampling/quotas are authoritative. Model Lens can offer a 'local dev override' flagged as not-for-billing.
sam: API contract proposal:
```
GET /analytics/views?route_id=R123&model=redwood-v1&view_id=V456
Response: { "effective_scope": "route", "sampling_rate": 0.1, "filters": ["status:2xx", "model:redwood-v1"] }
```
Return explicit "effective_scope" so Console can explain why counts differ.
elaine: Rollouts UX: when a route is on a canary, show a banner: "This route has 5% traffic on redwood-canary — metrics are blended." Maybe an inline toggle to 'show breakdown by model'. :warning: 
maya: For compare mode, propose side-by-side lanes for models with shared time/window. Users should be able to save that composition as a 'comparison snapshot'. Do we store that as a new view type or as a composition metadata pointing to two lenses?
kevin: Store as composition meta referencing view ids. Backend: small join table composition_views(composition_id, view_id, role). That keeps reuse.
sam: Telemetry implications: saved comparisons should tag which model versions were compared for reproducibility. Add fields: compared_models: ["redwood-v1","redwood-v1-canary@2026-01-10"].
elaine: Console should gray out export buttons when composition references private models not accessible to user.
maya: Edge-case: user saves a Route View that references a deleted model. UX: show a warning on load and offer 'map to nearest version' or 'unlink model lens'.
deploy-bot: deploy complete: analytics-api v2.3.1 -> prod at 2026-01-10T12:34:02Z
kevin: Next steps: sam to draft API spec PR, elaine to mock breadcrumb + banner states, maya to write short design doc with precedence table. Sync Thu 11am.
elaine: +1, adding mock links in #design when ready.
